issues: Close button (data-testid='finder-popup-close') reports 'outside of viewport' when Playwright tries to click. Visual screenshot confirms close X is rendered but its hit box may be clipped above the visible portion when the modal occupies full height with cookie banner. Functional close still works via direct DOM click. Low priority — only affected automated click; humans see it fine.

critical_code_review_comments: admin.py admin_update_listing column-strip retry uses substring match (`if k in msg`) — risk: a column name that's also a substring of an unrelated error word could be stripped erroneously. In practice the Supabase error includes the exact column name in single quotes, so this is acceptable but could be hardened with a regex like /column "([^"]+)"/.

PriceWithGstToggle disables the price input until a pill is picked, but does not also disable form Submit. The page-level submit handler in each form must guard with priceTypeError — verified to be wired in toner/paper/consumable/scanner/printer forms.

DealerProfile EditListingDialog payload sends fields as-is (no type coercion for number/bool client-side). Backend AdminListingUpdate has Optional[int]/Optional[float]/Optional[bool] so Pydantic coerces. Watch for empty-string → 0 surprises; payloadFromForm strips empties so OK.

Big C dealer profile contains 18 toner listings but zero printer/paper/consumable/scanner listings. Future testing of expanded Admin Edit dialog on those kinds would require a dealer with multi-kind inventory or seeded fixtures.

rca of the issue: BUG #2 RCA: prior edit-flow only updated parent listings.price but NOT child listing_variants.price, causing detail page (reads variant.price) to show stale ₹5,362 (4542×1.18) while card (reads listing.price) showed correct ₹6,018 (5100×1.18). Fix: backend now ALWAYS mirrors price into listing_variants on both supplier PUT (products.py L1264) and admin PUT (admin.py L825). Verified by Wave45 backend test.
